bash -lc cat > /tmp/cmp.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# compare direct vs eval.scm for tests without stdin
pass=0; fail=0; failed=""
for f in test/*.scm; do
  case "$f" in
    *06-interactive-io*|*calculator*|*test_read*) continue;;
  esac
  out1=$(timeout 20 python3 interp.py "$f" </dev/null 2>&1)
  c1=$?
  out2=$(printf '%s\n' "$f" | timeout 60 python3 interp.py eval.scm </dev/null 2>&1; printf '%s\n' "$f" | timeout 60 python3 interp.py eval.scm 2>&1)
  # simpler: feed filename only
  out2=$(printf '%s\n' "$f" | timeout 60 python3 interp.py eval.scm </dev/null 2>&1)
  # Actually need stdin = filename; program gets no further input. Use printf filename piped.
  out2=$(printf '%s\n' "$f" | timeout 60 python3 interp.py eval.scm 2>&1)
  if [ "$out1" = "$out2" ]; then pass=$((pass+1)); else fail=$((fail+1)); failed="$failed $f"; echo "FAIL: $f"; echo "--- direct:"; printf '%s\n' "$out1" | head -10; echo "--- via eval:"; printf '%s\n' "$out2" | head -10; echo;
  fi
done
echo "pass=$pass fail=$fail"
echo "failed:$failed"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/cmp.sh
/tmp/cmp.sh
